rows.description: A young adult gives all to friendships and causes and also gets overwhelmed and exhausted. Learning to ride waves, choose the timing of hard talks and keep routines supports depth without collapse.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17

rows.description: A child cries when another cries and offers a toy to comfort them. Feels with others but is still learning that their feelings are separate from mine.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child begins to understand why a friend is upset even when the child would not feel that way. Asks what happened and tries to help, and is nurtured when adults model it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager may feel others' pain deeply but not know what to do, while another understands feelings clearly but stays detached. Both are skills that develop with practice and reflection.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: detachment, empathy, hurt

rows.description: A caring young adult absorbs everyone's problems and becomes exhausted and resentful. Caring with limits, and separating compassion from rescuing, makes helping sustainable.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
related mind states: tiredness, resentment, empathy

rows.description: A wise person understands another's feelings without agreeing to everything or rescuing them. Empathy can sit beside firm boundaries, and both make relationships healthier.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: In many Indian homes a child learns that respect for elders and modesty matter, so opinions are held back at home while voiced freely with friends. Personality is shown differently in different rooms.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A boy told not to cry hides sadness and a girl told to be quiet hides ambition. Learned rules shape which traits feel safe, and adults who widen the range help teenagers become fuller selves.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: An eldest sibling grows into a responsible, serious role, caring for parents and younger ones and delaying own wants. Duty becomes identity, and sometimes hides tiredness and a wish for freedom.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A young person moving between village and city or home and abroad shifts style, language and boldness in each setting. It can feel like being two people, but flexibility is a strength if the core stays honest.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
